# testutil

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/pkg/secrets/internal/testutil"
```

Package testutil provides fake\-client test helpers shared by every reconciler package under pkg/secrets — scheme construction and ExternalSecret/Secret assertions. It lives under internal/ so it is only importable from within pkg/secrets, where it is exclusively test\-only code.
